help.building.rule: One action per turn: build a Building at level 1, build it directly at level 2, or upgrade a level 1 Building. Building costs 2 more gold for each Building you already have; upgrading does not.

help.age.name: Age token
help.age.lede: Put on every Unit still in play at the end of the turn. A Unit that already carries one dies at the next Aging phase.
help.age.deploy: Some card effects add an Age token (<ageplus/>) on a Unit.
help.age.aging: All Units that already have one or more Age tokens on them die: they are discarded with all the Age tokens placed on them. Then add one Age token on each Unit that is still in play.
help.age.end: Relics grant Legend points for each Age token they carry.
help.gold.name: Gold
help.gold.lede: The Gold of the Monarchs is never hidden. It pays the deployment cost of the Units and the land cost of the Buildings.
help.gold.deploy: Pay the cost of each Unit you reveal. A Unit you cannot pay for is discarded at once; a Unit already in play is never paid again.
help.gold.income: You earn {base} <gold/> from the reserve, plus the gold granted by the income effects <phase4/> of your Kingdom.
help.gold.build: Land cost: {cost} <gold/> for each Building you already have. Upgrading a Building costs no land.
help.gold.end: In case of a tie on Legend points, the Monarch with the most Gold wins.
help.turn.name: Turn counter
help.turn.lede: Turn {turn} of {turns}. In each phase, the Monarchs play simultaneously, then move on together to the next phase.
help.turn.1: Each Monarch receives 5 Unit cards (9 with 2 players), keeps one and passes the rest to a neighbour, until they hold 5 cards.
help.turn.1.left: This turn, the cards go to the left.
help.turn.1.right: This turn, the cards go to the right.
help.turn.2: The Monarchs put Units from their hand into play face down, then reveal them all at once and pay their cost.
help.turn.3: Each Kingdom compares its strength with its two neighbours: each War won (equal or greater strength) grants <pl3/>.
help.turn.4: Each Kingdom earns 2 <gold/>, plus the gold of its income effects.
help.turn.5: One action: construct a Building (at level 1 or directly at level 2), or upgrade a level 1 Building.
help.turn.6: The Units that carry an Age token die; the others get one.
help.turn.end: At the end of turn 4, each Monarch adds the Legend points of their Buildings. The most points wins; in case of a tie, the most Gold; otherwise victory is shared.

expansions.name: The expansions of this game
expansions.btg.units: Its 20 new Unit cards are in the draw pile.
expansions.btg.buildings: Buildings: each Monarch has the Mine, the Tavern, the Temple and the Town, plus 3 Buildings drawn at random among the Barracks and the Buildings of the expansions played.
expansions.wfl.cards: Its 26 new Unit cards and its 18 Legendary Artifacts are shuffled into the draw pile.
expansions.wfl.buildings: Buildings: 2 drawn at random among the Inn, the Sawmill and the Royal Palace are added to the 5 of the base game.
expansions.drawn: Drawn at random for this game: {buildings}. Each Monarch has the same {count} Buildings.
expansions.artifacts.recruit: They are selected exactly as Units are, during Recruitment phase, and the card that you keep for the turn to come can be an Artifact (still a single card).
expansions.artifacts.deploy: They are put into play at the same time as Units, face down, apart from them (at the right of your Buildings). No limit: they do not count towards the 4 (then 5) spots of your Units.
expansions.artifacts.cost: Each Artifact costs <g1/>, plus <g1/> for each Artifact already deployed: the 1st of the game costs 1, the 2nd 2, the 3rd 3… Several in a same turn are counted one after the other. You are never allowed to discard an Artifact in play to reduce the cost.
expansions.artifacts.effects: Their abilities apply exactly as those of Units and Buildings, every turn.
expansions.artifacts.age: They do not age: never add any <age/> on them, they remain in play until the end of the game.
expansions.artifacts.end: At the end of the game, add the <pl/> indicated on each of your Artifacts.
expansions.clar.shadow: Shadow: you can choose to re-trigger the abilities of a Unit that you just deployed during that phase.
expansions.clar.negative: Imp, Servile Minion: you actually earn the Gold indicated as a negative cost, which can pay right away for other Units.
expansions.clar.dryad: Dryad: you can provide any combination of resources that way, at the cost of 1 for 1.
expansions.clar.abbey: Abbey: if your Kingdom produces 2 <food/>, 1 <wood/> and 1 <crystal/>, Abbey earns you <pl4/>.
expansions.clar.port: Port: <pl2/> for each type of resource produced, whatever the amount.
expansions.clar.banner: Banner Bearer: check each condition on its own; with a Unit of cost 3 or more, you earn both <g2/> and <pl2/>.
expansions.clar.harvest: Relic of Harvest: in the Front with 3 <wood/> and 2 <food/>, it earns you <pl5/>; in the Back, nothing.
expansions.clar.jester: Court Jester: discard all revealed cards that are not an Artifact; the Artifact it puts into play costs nothing.
expansions.clar.titan: Titan: you neither pay the land cost, nor the resources of the level 2 Building.
help.artifact.cost.note: Cost = 1 + the Artifacts already deployed, here {count}
